name: nLIGHT, Inc.
blurb: nLIGHT, Inc. is a Vancouver, Washington-based manufacturer of high-power semiconductor and fiber lasers used in industrial, microfabrication, and aerospace/defense applications. The company designs its own laser chips and integrates them into complete laser systems, giving it vertical integration advantages over competitors. nLIGHT serves both commercial markets (sheet-metal cutting, welding) and growing defense markets (directed-energy weapons, beam-control systems). Its defense segment has become an increasingly important revenue driver as U.S. military demand for high-energy laser systems expands.
recent: nLIGHT reported a Q1 2026 earnings beat driven by surging defense demand and the launch of a new laser platform, sending shares sharply higher. Management issued upbeat guidance, citing defense-driven momentum as a key catalyst for the near-term outlook. The stock jumped following the print as investors reacted positively to both the outperformance and the forward visibility provided by growing government contracts.
